## FAQ

### When is Tet 2027?

Saturday 6 February 2027, the Year of the Goat. The Ministry of Home Affairs has proposed a seven-day holiday from 4 to 10 February (favoured) or ten days from 5 to 14 February; the decision is expected in autumn 2026.

### What are the Hoi An lantern festival dates in 2027?

First half of 2027: 21 January, 19 February, 21 March, 20 April, 19 May and 18 June — the 14th night of each lunar month.
